name: Kirishima Jun
source:
A popular student who is widely considered the most beautiful girl in the school. She is found dead at a train station, apparently committing suicide. [spoiler]In reality, she was murdered by Reiko after her husband, Kouji, accidentially impregnated her.[/spoiler]

In the Windows release, she also serves as the protagonist of the unlockable side story [i]Jun Kirishima: The Last 7 Days[/i]
